items.description: Report gives no numeric expected-versus-actual HYPE amounts or explicit minimum bound; the slippage relation is only qualitative ('less than expected'), so the bound is represented as a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric comparison.

Report does not state whether anyone can call queueWithdrawal or any authorization condition; no caller/authorization qualifier is encoded.
